Spotify announced today that Premium users in more than 75 countries can now interact with the platform’s AI-powered DJ, in an expansion that also includes support for four new languages. Here are the details.

Spotify DJ expands support to 75+ countries

Last October, Spotify brought Spanish support to personal DJ, its AI-powered feature that lets users make real-time music requests.

That same day, the company also added support for typed requests, expanding beyond the natural-language voice interactions that had launched with the beta the month before.

Today, Spotify expanded language support to French with DJ Maïa, German with DJ Ben, Italian with DJ Alex, and Brazilian Portuguese with DJ Dani.

Additionally, the company expanded the feature’s availability to more than 75 countries, in a list that now includes Austria, Brazil, France, Germany, Italy, Portugal, South Korea, and Switzerland.

Here’s Spotify on what the feature offers:

For those who haven’t met DJ yet, it offers a personalized mix of music and commentary to help you discover new favorites and connect more deeply with the artists you love. Based on your listening history, it lines up songs you’ll enjoy—bringing together your favorite tracks, songs you haven’t heard in years, and new releases to keep things feeling fresh.

Spotfy’s personal DJ feature is available to Premium users, who can either look for DJ in the search field, or tap to start a personalized session from Spotify’s home page.

DJ can take a wide range of natural-language requests, including looser prompts based on the vibe users are in the mood for, the activity they are doing, or the kind of moment they want to soundtrack.
